# pantechdynamics_domain (Data Source)

Looks up one domain registered to your organization, by id or name (such as "example.com"), for example to point records at it or to read when it expires. The registrant contact is not exposed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look a domain of your organization up by name (or by id).
data "pantechdynamics_domain" "example" {
  name = "example.com"
}

output "expires_at" {
  value = data.pantechdynamics_domain.example.expires_at
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Id of the domain to look up, starting with dom_. Set exactly one of id and name.
- `name` (String) Name of the domain to look up. It must match exactly. Names are unique in the account. Set exactly one of id and name.

### Read-Only

- `auto_renew` (Boolean) Whether the domain renews from credit before it expires.
- `contact_verified` (Boolean) Whether the registrant verified their email with the registry.
- `expires_at` (String) When the registration expires, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `name_server_mode` (String) "pantech" (Pantech DNS) or "custom".
- `name_servers` (List of String) The name servers the domain is delegated to.
- `privacy` (Boolean) Whether the registrant is hidden from public lookups.
- `registered_at` (String) When the domain was registered, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `status` (String) State of the domain, for example "active" or "expired".
- `tld` (String) The domain's top-level domain, such as "com".
- `transfer_lock` (Boolean) Whether transfers to another registrar are refused.
- `zone_id` (String) Id of the Pantech DNS zone the domain is delegated to, or null.
